title: UMBRELLA: consolidate the Cubric family into Cubric Vision
description: Fabio, 2026-09-01, reordered by Fabio 2026-09-08: Cubric Vision becomes the all-in-one and the siblings retire. THE GOAL IS THAT NOBODY OPENS THE CUBRIC-PROMPT REPO AGAIN. Order by PRIORITY, not by the old A-D letters: (1) the enhance button becomes in-app - one control, ONE PATH, every model, every workflow, replacing the broker call out to Cubric Prompt; (2) cut the cord - delete the broker surface and Vision's @cubric/connector dependency; (3) archive Cubric-Prompt on Fabio's go; (4) the corpus retrieval path, the cubric-vision skill split (MPI-593 owns it), the recipe build/heal loop; (5) LAST, the agent that talks to the user, where Qwen 3.8 27B gets evaluated. The recipe layer already landed 2026-09-08 (gate: Cubric-Prompt MPI-35, closed complete) - js/data/recipes/, docs/recipes/playbook/ + research/, tests/recipe-registry.test.cjs and the Stage 1 harness behind `npm run recipe:test`, all verified on disk here, claim audit 13 proven / 0 false. Nothing in Vision calls them yet; that is step 1. ENHANCE CONTROL SETTLED (Fabio, 2026-09-08, SINGLE PATH): one button in the wand's position; clicking ALWAYS opens an overlay - short prompt above, editable enhanced text below, OK/Cancel - on every model, with no per-model branching. The in-graph enhancer is turned OFF (Input_enhance_prompt forced false on krea2_t2i_sfw/nsfw, klein_t2i, klein_9b_t2i), so enhancement stops being a property of the workflow. Fabio's reasoning: with a DeepInfra key there is no GPU tax on ANY model, so the free in-graph enhance only ever helped 4 of 12 models on the local path. Backend is a SETTING not per-model behaviour: DeepInfra default, the ComfyUI encoder as the local/uncensored path on the 4 eligible models (it reuses weights a generation already loads, where Ollama is a second runtime with a duplicate copy on the same card), Ollama for the other 8. Settings toggle and the two Flow-internal enhance buttons fold in. Renames in flight elsewhere: Vision -> 'Cubric Studio', the Studio repo -> 'Cubric-Connector' (renamed, NOT deleted), @cubric/ui already deprecated on npm. Plan: plan.md. CHILD CARD: MPI-708 renames the product to Cubric Studio (repo, app, mascots, sites) - the repo renames go hub-to-Cubric-Connector FIRST to free the name, then Cubric-Vision to Cubric-Studio, which means step 2's `file:../Cubric-Studio` dependency path changes if that rename lands first.
